statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent episodes of syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1, R55)
Diagnosis codes I47.1 and R55 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is medically necessary for comprehensive evaluation
